name: Fire Outside the Building (Example)
summary: EXAMPLE ONLY. A sample workflow for demonstrating work centers and schedules — not a real fire procedure.

checklist.title: Before you start
checklist.intro: Example workflow only. It is here to show branching, parallel tracks and scheduling. It is not a fire procedure and must not be used in a real emergency.
items: Site plan showing yard, tanks and vehicle parking
Outside air intake and damper controls

question.prompt: Which way is the wind pushing the fire?
question.help: Smoke reaching the building is what decides whether people shelter inside or leave.
question.label: Wind

steps.title: Find it on the cameras
steps.body: Locate the fire on the yard cameras. Note what is burning and how close it is to the building, tanks or parked vehicles.

steps.title: Check the wind
steps.body: Look at the flag, the smoke plume or the weather feed. Wind direction drives the rest of this procedure.

steps.title: Smoke toward the building
steps.body: Shut the outside air intake and close the dampers. Keep everyone inside with the windows shut.

steps.title: Smoke away from the building
steps.body: Normal ventilation can stay on. Keep watching — this is the condition most likely to change.

steps.title: Shifting or calm
steps.body: Treat it as if the smoke is coming your way. Shut the intake now rather than waiting to be sure.

steps.title: Call emergency services
steps.body: Give the address, the gate code, what is burning and the nearest hydrant or water point.

steps.title: Open the gate for them
steps.body: Unlock the approach the fire service will use and keep that lane clear.

steps.title: Clear the yard
steps.body: Get people away from the fire side of the site and move them indoors or to the far assembly point.

steps.title: Move what will burn
steps.body: If it is safe and quick, move vehicles and pallets away from the fire. If it is not, leave them.

steps.title: Account for outside staff
steps.body: Radio anyone working outdoors — yard, roof, loading dock — and confirm each one is clear.

steps.title: Watch for spread
steps.body: Keep the cameras on the fire and tell the fire service at once if it reaches a structure, a tank or a vehicle.

steps.title: Log it and stand by
steps.body: Record the time, what was burning, the wind, and who was notified. Stand by for the all-clear.
